# Meet Barcelona

> > Official Barcelona City Council portal for tourism, business investment, research, and events in the Mediterranean capital of Catalonia.

Meet Barcelona serves as the municipality's comprehensive platform showcasing the city's districts (Gràcia, Sant Martí, Sarrià-Sant Gervasi), natural spaces (Montjuïc, Collserola, Barceloneta beach), business ecosystem (Barcelona Activa, Barcelona Investment Office), and cultural identity including gastronomy, design, and Catalan traditions.

## Key Topics

- Barcelona neighborhoods and districts
- Mediterranean location and geography
- Barcelona Investment Office
- Barcelona Activa entrepreneurship
- Parks and natural spaces (Montjuïc, Collserola, Parc de Collserola)
- Beaches and outdoor activities
- Business hub and economic development
- Trade fairs and congresses
- Catalan identity and culture
- Design and modernisme architecture
- Gastronomy and haute cuisine
- Quality of life
- 22@ tech district
- Barcelona City Council services
- Tourism and urban exploration

## Business & Investment

- [Barcelona Investment Office](https://www.meet.barcelona/en/invest-and-do-business/barcelona-investment-office): Municipal service for coordinated investment support via Barcelona Activa
- [Barcelona Investment Office (FR)](https://www.meet.barcelona/fr/investir-et-faire-des-affaires/barcelona-investment-office): Barcelona Investment Office: municipal support for business installation
- [Barcelone Centre d'affaires](https://www.meet.barcelona/fr/investir-et-faire-des-affaires/barcelone-centre-daffaires): Barcelona business hub: entrepreneurship, startups, 4YFN, Barcelona Activa
- [Barcelona of Fairs and Congresses](https://www.meet.barcelona/en/invest-and-do-business/trade-fairs-and-conferences): Barcelona's trade fairs, congresses, and ICCA-ranked convention facilities
- [Écoles de commerce Barcelone](https://www.meet.barcelona/fr/etude-et-recherche/ecoles-de-commerce-et-autres-institutions): Barcelona business schools: IESE, ESADE, EADA, Barcelona GSE

## Barcelona Identity & Culture

- [The identity](https://www.meet.barcelona/en/visit-and-love-it/barcelona-and-identity/identity): Barcelona's Catalan identity: Sant Jordi, cuisine, modernisme, human towers
- [La ciudad](https://www.meet.barcelona/es/visitala-y-amala/barcelona-y-la-identidad/la-ciudad): Barcelona geography: districts, Mediterranean beaches, Besòs-Llobregat rivers
- [Barcelona és qualitat de vida](https://www.meet.barcelona/ca/visita-la-i-estima-la/barcelona-es-qualitat-de-vida): Barcelona's quality of life: Mediterranean climate, parks, local commerce
- [Modern and industrial Barcelona](https://www.meet.barcelona/en/visit-and-love-it/modern-industrial-city): Barcelona's industrial past from 18th-19th century Crown of Aragon era

## City Districts & Neighborhoods

- [Sant Martí](https://www.meet.barcelona/en/points-interest-city/sant-marti): Sant Martí district: industrial heritage transformed into 22@ tech hub
- [Gràcia](https://www.meet.barcelona/ca/punts-dinteres-de-la-ciutat/gracia): Gràcia district: bohemian neighborhood with Park Güell and Festa Major
- [Sarrià - Sant Gervasi](https://www.meet.barcelona/es/visitala-y-amala/puntos-de-interes-de-la-ciudad/sarria-sant-gervasi): Sarrià-Sant Gervasi district: gateway to Collserola via Tibidabo

## Nature & Outdoor Barcelona

- [Emplacement](https://www.meet.barcelona/fr/visitez-la-et-aimez-la/le-lieu): Barcelona's strategic Mediterranean location with beaches and natural areas
- [Naturaleza y playas de Barcelona](https://www.meet.barcelona/es/visitala-y-amala/barcelona-al-aire-libre): Outdoor Barcelona: Barceloneta beach, Montjuïc park, Collserola sierra

## Gastronomy & Markets

- [Cuisine d'auteur](https://www.meet.barcelona/fr/gastronomie/la-cuisine-dauteur): Barcelona's haute cuisine: Ferran Adrià, El Bulli, Jordi Cruz, ABaC
- [Bodegas donde hacer el vermú](https://www.meet.barcelona/es/visitala-y-amala/gastronomia/el-vermu-una-tradicion-con-historia): Traditional vermú culture in Barcelona bodegas like Casa Mariol
- [Mercats Modernistes](https://www.meet.barcelona/ca/visita-la-i-estima-la/els-mercats/mercats-modernistes): Modernist markets: Mercat de la Llibertat, Sants, and Galvany

## Design & Cultural Routes

- [Circuit de la BCN du Design](https://www.meet.barcelona/fr/visitez-la-et-aimez-la/le-design-de-lartisanat-lere-post-industrielle): Design route through Barcelona's urban spaces and Design Museum
- [Film set Route](https://www.meet.barcelona/en/visit-and-love-it/film-sets): Barcelona film locations route from Lumière brothers to modern cinema

## Essential

- [Meet Barcelona Homepage](https://www.meet.barcelona/en): Homepage: tourism, investment, research, and events in Barcelona
